# ckbadger

ckbadger is a CKB blockchain explorer.

Primary markdown rule:

- Explorer pages are scoped by network: `/{network}/...`.
- Append `.md` to a network-scoped page URL to get a markdown representation.
- Markdown frontmatter includes `buildVersion`.
- Example: `/mainnet/blocks/123.md`, `/testnet/tx/0x....md`,
  `/mainnet/charts/hash-rate.md`.

Machine-friendly endpoints:

- Shared API base: `/api/{network}/v1`
- Direct per-network API base: `/api/v1` on that API's configured port
- Markdown pages: `/{network}/{page}.md`
- Raw pages: `/{network}/{page}.raw`
  - Optional profile: `?profile=default|debugger`
  - Example: `/mainnet/tx/0x....raw?profile=debugger`
  - Example: `/mainnet/identities/dotbit/{identityId}.raw`
  - Example: `/testnet/identities/did/{identityId}.raw`
  - Example: `/mainnet/identities/bit-cell/{identityId}.raw`
  - Example: `/mainnet/identities/dotcell/{identityId}.raw`
  - Example: `/mainnet/objects/mnft/{objectId}.raw`
  - `profile=debugger` returns `mockTransaction` for `ckb-debugger --tx-file`
  - `/tx/{hash}.raw` also includes `data.txWitness` (witness analyses + inference)
  - Raw response `meta` includes `buildVersion`
  - Raw response headers: `x-ckbadger-format`, `x-ckbadger-profile`, `x-ckbadger-schema`
- Capability descriptor: `/capabilities` (JSON)
- Address physical holdings: `/api/{network}/v1/addresses/{addr}/holdings` returns an exact
  current-owner capacity partition, six live-cell classes and four holding-kind counts.
  `/api/{network}/v1/addresses/{addr}/cells?class=dao|token|object|identity|script|plain&limit=50&cursor=...`
  filters before cursor pagination. Identity `heldSinceBlock` traces uninterrupted ownership;
  `createdAtBlock` describes the current cell. Protocol-named `.cell` rights remain separate at
  `/api/{network}/v1/addresses/{addr}/dotcell-names` and add no physical capacity.
- Inventory summary: `/api/{network}/v1/assets/summary` reads canonical counts at its returned
  anchor; `/assets` is a separately refreshed cached listing. Collection composition groups and
  exact live DOB-pending item counts are distinct.
- Token history: `/api/{network}/v1/tokens/{typeHash}/history` supplies complete UTC+8 daily
  capacity/supply, complete weekly transfers and exact mint/burn events. `/distribution` supplies
  same-view concentration and balance buckets; `/holders` includes its own `totalSupply` and
  anchor for exact row shares. `/activity-feed` and `/transactions` expose both paginated layers.
  Issuer is nullable and requires script proof; stored name/symbol/decimals provenance is not
  recorded. Unknown decimals remain raw integer amounts.
- Exact live-cell inventory: `/api/{network}/v1/cells/live-summary` (constant-size JSON; verify
  `tip.block`/`tip.hash` against the local CKB node)
- Optional local peer evidence: `/api/{network}/v1/network/summary`,
  `/api/{network}/v1/network/peers`, and `/api/{network}/v1/network/peers/{peerId}`. Evidence keeps
  Discovery advertisements, configured-local-node direct sessions, session initiation direction,
  and `crawlerDialState` separate through explicit `participation` booleans. `observerInitiated`
  means local RPC `get_peers.is_outbound` was true; `peerInitiated` means it was false. A
  direct-only peer can have no dial address, and session addresses are never crawler aliases.
  `exhausted` means only that this crawler did not
  verify retained aliases in that completed round; it does not imply NAT/firewall, “home node”,
  global invalidity, or offline status.
